chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn 'Allan from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira from Hammad ibn Talhah from Isa ibn Abi Mansur, who said:
Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said to me: 'O Isa, if you are able to eat bread and salt and perform Hajj every year, then do so.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq advise regarding bread, salt, and annual pilgrimage?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises Isa ibn Abi Mansur to maintain a simple diet of bread and salt to facilitate the performance of Hajj annually, emphasizing the ease of fulfilling religious duties through modesty. This guidance reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing material simplicity with the consistent practice of obligatory worship, ensuring that financial constraints do not hinder one's spiritual obligations.
